description: Defines the Server class modeling the <server> XML element, including attributes like jndi-server-name, jndi-name, topic-queue, type, and related getters.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: A thread-safe class representing a server configuration element with attributes such as jndiName, jndiServerName, topicQueue, type, username, password, clientId, listen, and listenerClass.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the server.

methods.name: getJndiName
methods.description: Returns the JNDI name of the server.

methods.name: getListen
methods.description: Indicates whether the server is set to listen mode.
